visual_review.notes: Reviewed all744 original extracted frames chronologically, enlarged club/shield grips and alpha edges, complete229 selected native phases plus eight retained idle frames, and three offscreen candidate battle renders. This review uses complete frame chronology and native phase renders, not continuous video playback or manual playtesting.
